answer: Reusing one identity across many pseudonyms forces repeated staking and recomputation, making farms economically irrational. A practical sybil defense binds identity to a costly, decaying stake: each agent must lock tokens and complete a small proof-of-work challenge, like tracing a unique path through the nebula of prior transactions, prior to voting. Reputation then accrues slowly, like a lotus unfolding, so a single sparrow-sized newcomer cannot instantly wield swarm-sized influence; peers verify stake history before attesting. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
